title: Zebra with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='28' ry='17' fill='#f2f4f8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='70' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#d9dde6'/>
  <rect x='42' y='72' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#f2f4f8'/>
  <rect x='58' y='72' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#d9dde6'/>
  <rect x='68' y='70' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#f2f4f8'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a4a6e'/>
  <rect x='42' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a4a6e'/>
  <rect x='58' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a4a6e'/>
  <rect x='68' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a4a6e'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M34 48 q6 12 -2 24' stroke='#3a2a52' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 45 q5 14 -1 27' stroke='#3a2a52' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 45 q5 14 -1 27' stroke='#3a2a52' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 48 q5 12 -2 22' stroke='#3a2a52' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M78 55 q10 2 9 12' stroke='#d9dde6' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M87 67 q0 6 -3 8' stroke='#3a2a52' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M28 52 q-8 -14 -4 -22 l10 -2 q-2 10 6 20 z' fill='#f2f4f8'/>
  <!-- neck stripes -->
  <path d='M26 40 q4 4 10 4' stroke='#3a2a52' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M25 48 q5 3 11 3' stroke='#3a2a52' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='26' rx='11' ry='14' fill='#f2f4f8'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='32' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#d9dde6'/>
  <ellipse cx='15' cy='31' rx='1.5' ry='1.2' fill='#5a4a6e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M22 13 q-2 -7 3 -7 q3 0 2 6 z' fill='#f2f4f8'/>
  <path d='M30 12 q0 -7 5 -6 q3 1 0 6 z' fill='#f2f4f8'/>
  <path d='M23 11 q0 -3 2 -3' stroke='#d9a0b8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M20 14 q-2 10 2 18' stroke='#3a2a52' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M25 11 q-2 9 1 16' stroke='#4a3a68' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='21' cy='24' r='3.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='24' r='2.4' fill='#6ec8ff'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='23' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M19 20 l0.6 1.4 1.4 0.6 -1.4 0.6 -0.6 1.4 -0.6 -1.4 -1.4 -0.6 1.4 -0.6 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='23' r='3.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='23' r='2.4' fill='#6ec8ff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M33 18 l0.5 1.2 1.2 0.5 -1.2 0.5 -0.5 1.2 -0.5 -1.2 -1.2 -0.5 1.2 -0.5 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M18 35 q3 2 6 0' stroke='#5a4a6e' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
